text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Argh... Damn it!

At the invitation of an instructor, I 
dropped in on an Umamusume class to 
observe, when—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
How can I become the strongest if I run 
like a slug?!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Espoir City-san?!
If you run any more, 
the strain on your legs will――

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Annoying! I know what condition my own 
legs are in, duh!

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, why can't you just listen for 
once?! What if you got hurt the moment I 
looked away...!
choice_data_list: If it's alright, I can keep an eye...
If it's alright, I can keep an eye...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... *whew*... One more 
set... Next, pull the knees up...
choice_data_list: If you'd like, I can keep an eye o...
If you'd like, I can keep an eye o...

text_block_list.text:
I observe her continuing to train alone, 
ignoring the instructor's directions. I 
intend to stop her if she looks at her 
limit, but――
choice_data_list: (Looks like she still has plenty l...
(Looks like she still has plenty l...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...What the hell are you looking at?!
Stop 
staring at me!
choice_data_list: (Looks like her legs still have pl...
(Looks like her legs still have pl...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You think you can boss me around on your 
high horse too?!
choice_data_list: ...? Do *you* want me to give you ...
...? Do *you* want me to give you ...
I won't. Just think of me as a gra...
I won't. Just think of me as a gra...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You think you can boss me around on your 
high horse too?!
choice_data_list: ...? Does 'you' want me to give in...
...? Does 'you' want me to give in...
I won't. Just pretend I'm a grain ...
I won't. Just pretend I'm a grain ...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't need it! I can take care of my own 
business!
choice_data_list: ...? Does 'you' want me to give in...
...? Does 'you' want me to give in...
I won't. Just pretend I'm a grain ...
I won't. Just pretend I'm a grain ...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I remember every single lap I've run. I 
know exactly how many laps it takes
before 
I break down.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Who the hell asked for your input?! Huh?!
choice_data_list: I see, looks like I don't need to ...
I see, looks like I don't need to ...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch...―― Don't underestimate me. I ain't 
got time to be getting injured.
choice_data_list: I see, doesn't look like we have t...
I see, doesn't look like we have t...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ――Take thiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Like I could ever think that, idiot!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
who cares about dirt! Then I'll just 
trample right through it! Raargh!!
choice_data_list: I'd rather not get stepped on……

text_block_list.name: Surrounding Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
(Whisper whisper... Step on an adult...? 
Whisper whisper... Espo-san sure is wild!)
choice_data_list: I'd rather not get stepped on, tho...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ngh... damn it!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Get lost, idiot!! You're getting in the 
way of my run!!
choice_data_list: Give it your all in training!
Do your best in training!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Shut up!! I thought this was supposed to 
be sand!
choice_data_list: Work hard in training!
Work hard in training!

text_block_list.text:
And so, I watched over her training. 
Though she acted like a rebellious teen, 
she took her running with utmost 
seriousness.
